# QR Platby API — Full Reference

> Complete API reference for the QR Platby QR code generation endpoint. Generate QR codes for Slovak and Czech bank payments in BySquare, EPC, and SPAYD formats. Free, no authentication required.

## Endpoint

```
POST https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr
```

Content-Type: `application/json`

CORS is enabled for all origins. An `OPTIONS` preflight returns `204` with appropriate headers.

## Request Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `iban` | string | Yes | — | Recipient IBAN (e.g. `SK3112000000198742637541`). Slovak and Czech IBANs supported. |
| `amount` | number | No | — | Payment amount, range `0.01` – `999999999.99` |
| `currency` | string | No | `"EUR"` | Currency code: `"EUR"` or `"CZK"` |
| `variableSymbol` | string | No | — | Variable symbol, up to 10 digits (digits only) |
| `specificSymbol` | string | No | — | Specific symbol, up to 10 digits (digits only) |
| `constantSymbol` | string | No | — | Constant symbol, up to 4 digits (digits only) |
| `recipientName` | string | No | — | Payee name, up to 70 characters (cut to 35 for `spayd`). Use the exact account holder name. Required for `epc`. Expected for `bysquare`: Slovak banks verify it against the IBAN, and a code without it returns a `warnings` entry. |
| `paymentNote` | string | No | — | Payment note / message, up to 140 characters (cut to 60 for `spayd`) |
| `bic` | string | No | — | BIC/SWIFT code (8 or 11 characters). Supported by all formats. |
| `paymentDueDate` | string | No | — | Payment due date in `YYYY-MM-DD` format. `bysquare` and `spayd` only. |
| `invoiceId` | string | No | — | Invoice number, up to 10 characters. `bysquare` only. |
| `spaydReference` | string | No | — | SPAYD recipient reference (RF), up to 16 digits. `spayd` only. |
| `purposeCode` | string | No | — | SEPA purpose code (AT-44), up to 4 characters (e.g. `GDDS`). `epc` only. |
| `instantPayment` | boolean | No | `false` | Request an instant payment (SPAYD `PT:IP`) where the payer's bank supports it. `spayd` only. |
| `paymentFormat` | string | No | `"bysquare"` | Payment format: `"bysquare"` (Slovak PAY by square), `"spayd"` (Czech QR Platba), or `"epc"` (EU SEPA). EPC requires EUR currency and recipientName. A field sent for a format that does not support it is rejected (e.g. `invoiceId` is bysquare-only, `spaydReference` spayd-only, `purposeCode` epc-only; EPC rejects symbol fields, `paymentDueDate`, `invoiceId`, `spaydReference`). |
| `format` | string | No | `"png"` | Output format: `"png"` (base64 data URI) or `"svg"` (SVG markup) |
| `size` | integer | No | `300` | QR code size in pixels, range `100` – `1000`. Applies to PNG width/height and SVG intrinsic width/height. |
| `darkColor` | string | No | `"#000000"` | Foreground hex color (`#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`). |
| `lightColor` | string | No | `"#ffffff"` | Background hex color (`#RRGGBB` or `#RRGGBBAA`). Use `#FFFFFF00` for a transparent background. |
| `margin` | integer | No | `2` | Quiet zone width in QR modules, range `0` – `10`. Reducing below 2 may hurt scanner reliability. |
| `errorCorrectionLevel` | string | No | auto | Override the auto-derived error correction level: `"L"` (7%), `"M"` (15%), `"Q"` (25%), or `"H"` (30% recovery). Payload may not fit at lower levels. |

## Response — Success (200)

```json
{
  "success": true,
  "data": "data:image/png;base64,iVBORw0KGgo...",
  "format": "png",
  "iban": "SK3112000000198742637541",
  "amount": 25.50,
  "currency": "EUR"
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `success` | `true` | Always `true` on success |
| `data` | string | Base64 data URI (PNG) or SVG markup string (SVG) |
| `format` | string | `"png"` or `"svg"` |
| `iban` | string | Normalized IBAN (spaces removed, uppercased) |
| `amount` | number | Echoed back if provided in request |
| `currency` | string | `"EUR"` or `"CZK"` |
| `warnings` | string[] | Optional. Non-fatal notes, e.g. `recipientName` missing for `bysquare` |

### Rate Limit Headers (Success)

| Header | Description |
|---|---|
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Maximum requests per window |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Remaining requests in current window |

## Response — Validation Error (400)

Returned when request parameters fail validation.

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "VALIDATION_ERROR",
    "message": "Validation failed. Check the issues array for details.",
    "issues": [
      { "path": "iban", "message": "Invalid IBAN" },
      { "path": "amount", "message": "Amount must be at least 0.01" }
    ]
  }
}
```

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `success` | `false` | Always `false` on error |
| `error.code` | string | `"VALIDATION_ERROR"` |
| `error.message` | string | Human-readable summary |
| `error.issues` | array | List of `{ path, message }` objects describing each validation failure |

## Response — Rate Limit (429)

Returned when per-IP rate limits are exceeded.

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "RATE_LIMIT",
    "message": "Rate limit exceeded. Limit is 20 requests/minute and 100 requests/day. Retry after 42 seconds."
  }
}
```

### Rate Limit Headers (429)

| Header | Description |
|---|---|
| `X-RateLimit-Limit` | Maximum requests per window |
| `X-RateLimit-Remaining` | Always `0` when rate limited |
| `Retry-After` | Seconds until rate limit resets |

### Rate Limits

- **20 requests per minute** per IP address
- **100 requests per day** per IP address
- No authentication or API key required

## Response — Internal Error (500)

```json
{
  "success": false,
  "error": {
    "code": "INTERNAL_ERROR",
    "message": "QR code generation failed"
  }
}
```

## Error Codes Summary

| Code | HTTP Status | When |
|---|---|---|
| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 | Invalid request parameters (bad IBAN, amount out of range, etc.) |
| `RATE_LIMIT` | 429 | Per-IP rate limit exceeded (20/min or 100/day) |
| `INTERNAL_ERROR` | 500 | Unexpected server error |

## Examples

### curl — Basic Payment

```bash
curl -X POST https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"iban":"SK3112000000198742637541","amount":25.50,"variableSymbol":"2024001"}'
```

### curl — IBAN Only (Minimal)

```bash
curl -X POST https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"iban":"SK3112000000198742637541"}'
```

### curl — SVG Format with Czech CZK

```bash
curl -X POST https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"iban":"CZ6508000000192000145399","amount":1500,"currency":"CZK","recipientName":"Jan Novák","format":"svg"}'
```

### curl - SPAYD (Czech QR Platba)

```bash
curl -X POST https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"iban":"CZ6508000000192000145399","amount":1500,"currency":"CZK","recipientName":"Jan Novák","paymentFormat":"spayd"}'
```

### JavaScript (fetch)

```javascript
const response = await fetch("https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr", {
  method: "POST",
  headers: { "Content-Type": "application/json" },
  body: JSON.stringify({
    iban: "SK3112000000198742637541",
    amount: 25.50,
    variableSymbol: "2024001",
  }),
});

const result = await response.json();

if (result.success) {
  // result.data contains base64 PNG data URI — use directly in <img src>
  console.log(result.data);
} else {
  console.error(result.error.code, result.error.message);
}
```

### Python (requests)

```python
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr",
    json={
        "iban": "SK3112000000198742637541",
        "amount": 25.50,
        "variableSymbol": "2024001",
    },
)

result = response.json()

if result["success"]:
    # result["data"] contains base64 PNG data URI
    print(result["data"])
else:
    print(result["error"]["code"], result["error"]["message"])
```

### Python — Save QR as PNG File

```python
import base64
import requests

response = requests.post(
    "https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr",
    json={"iban": "SK3112000000198742637541", "amount": 100},
)

result = response.json()

if result["success"]:
    # Strip the data URI prefix and decode
    b64_data = result["data"].split(",", 1)[1]
    with open("payment-qr.png", "wb") as f:
        f.write(base64.b64decode(b64_data))
```

## EPC QR (European SEPA)

EPC QR codes are available via the API using `"paymentFormat": "epc"`. Requirements:
- Currency must be `"EUR"` (EPC only supports EUR)
- `recipientName` is required
- Supports `bic` and `purposeCode` (SEPA AT-44, e.g. `GDDS`)
- `variableSymbol`, `specificSymbol`, `constantSymbol`, `paymentDueDate`, `invoiceId`, and `spaydReference` are NOT supported (will return validation error)

### curl - EPC QR (EU SEPA)

```bash
curl -X POST https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"iban":"DE89370400440532013000","amount":100,"paymentFormat":"epc","recipientName":"Max Mustermann","purposeCode":"GDDS"}'
```

### curl - Slovak payment with due date and invoice number

```bash
curl -X POST https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/qr \
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \
  -d '{"iban":"SK3112000000198742637541","amount":25.50,"variableSymbol":"2024001","paymentDueDate":"2026-12-31","invoiceId":"2024001"}'
```

## Usage Stats Endpoint

`GET https://qr-platby.com/api/v1/stats` returns anonymous usage counters. No auth, no PII, cached for 10 minutes.

```json
{ "total": 12345, "last30Days": 987, "api": 2100 }
```

- `total` - QR codes generated in the web app, all time
- `last30Days` - QR codes generated in the web app over the last 30 days
- `api` - QR codes generated via the REST API, all time
